title: Integris Medtech IPO
summary: Integris Medtech IPO is a book-built issue, to be listed on BSE and NSE. The IPO opens on November 27, 2026 and closes on December 1, 2026, with allotment expected on December 2 and listing on December 4, 2026. The price band and lot size are yet to be announced.

b.p: Integris Medtech IPO has a total issue size of ₹600.00 Crores Fresh + 1,08,37,266 Shares OFS and will be listed on BSE and NSE. Price band & Lot size details are yet to be announced.

kv: ICICI Securities Ltd., Axis Capital Pvt.Ltd., Citigroup Global Markets India Pvt.Ltd., IIFL Capital Services Ltd.

Integris Medtech financials show revenue growth and profitability trends over recent years, indicating business stability.

Founded in 2008, Integris Medtech Ltd is an India based international company which manufactures and provides global medical products and laboratory solutions for medical products and laboratory solutions. The company designs, manufactures, markets, and distributes an extensive range of medical devices and solutions that include cardiovascular devices, clinical diagnostics, and scientific laboratory solutions. · Integris Medtech has operations located in India, Germany, and the Netherlands. It sells its product line in more than 65 international markets in India, Europe, and Southeast Asia. The company's customer segment comprises of more than 9,500 laboratories and 2,000 hospitals and cathlabs and a portfolio of over 22,000 SKUs with more than 200 brands of laboratory and cardiovascular segments. · · The core divisions of the company's operations include: · Cardiovascular Devices – including drug eluting stents, drug coated balloons, advanced coronary interventions and vascular access. · Laboratory Solutions – including clinical, research, and industrial laboratory devices, reagents, and consumables, as well as instrumentation service such as installation, maintenance and calibration via its BioCal product line. · · The firm caters to laboratories and hospital facilities situated in India, Singapore, Thailand, Malaysia, and the Philippines, serving the government sector as well as private sector entities. · · European operations of the company deal mostly with products used in cardiology, which include its own product range, namely the Chrome and Protégé series of instruments. · By June 30, 2025, Integris Medtech boasted 1,879 employees, which were sales, service, and application experts. Moreover, more than 15,000 patients were supported by the company through more than 100 clinical trial sites in various parts of the world.
Evercure Holdings Pte.Ltd., Medicore Holdings Pte.Ltd., Gurmit Singh Chugh, Punita Sharma are the company's promoters of Integris Medtech.
